Subject: Training deep-dive & environment prep

Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks again for scheduling next week's console + API deep-dive for our integrations team. We've run into a calendar conflict: three of the seven engineers will be in a mandatory offsite on the originally booked date (May 10).

Can we please move the session? Preferable windows for us:
- Tue May 16, 9:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu May 18, 13:00–15:00 PT (backup)

A few asks from our side:
- Can you share the onboarding prep checklist so we can pre-provision test service accounts?
- We will need a short runbook for the API keys/roles so our infra team can confirm firewall rules in time.
- Attendees: Emma Wallace (PM), Rahul Singh (SRE), Mia Lopez (Backend), Jason Wu (Frontend), Sales Ops (cc).

If either of those slots won't work for you, happy to propose other times next week. Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can unblock our team.

Thanks,
Emma Wallace
Head of Integrations | ClearWave

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wallace <emma@clearwave.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Training deep-dive & environment prep

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads-up.

Both proposed windows are workable for us; Ben is the trainer for this engagement and he flagged that Tue May 16, 9:00–11:00 PT would be ideal (gives us time to run a quick dry-run on Monday). Can you confirm that your SREs will have the ability to create a test VM or share IP allowlist entries? If not, we can narrow the session to just console/API walkthrough and move the integration lab to later in the week.

I've attached our onboarding prep checklist and a small CSV template you can use for service account details. Also linking the short runbook and the pre-session permissions matrix below. Please fill the template and reply with the completed file; we will provision access the afternoon before the session.

Attachments: onboarding-prep-checklist.pdf, clearwave-service-account-template.csv
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleRunbook

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm preferred slot (May 16 or May 18)
2) Your team completes the service-account CSV by EOD Monday (May 14)
3) Ben and I run a 30-min trainer dry-run Mon May 15, 4pm PT (we'll send a calendar invite)

If May 16 works, I will send an updated calendar invite with dial-in and pre-read.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Support: +1 (415) 555-0112

Tessa — sounds good. I'm free Tue May 16, 8:30–11:30 PT for the session and can do the dry-run Mon May 15 at 16:00 PT.

Quick note on agenda: 30m console walkthrough (roles, keys, runbook), 45m API deep-dive (auth, batching, KV cache behavior), 30m hands-on lab (we'll need Rahul or your SRE to verify access for the test VM), 15m Q&A. I can tighten timing if you want a shorter day.

I'll wait for Emma to confirm time and will prepare a short trainer notes doc to send ahead of the dry-run.

—Ben

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the dry-run on Mon May 15 — pls send the invite.

Best,
